# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Need to filter movies in Simple Note by director 'Peter Jackson' and extract titles.</uncertainty>
access_token='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzaW1wbGVfbm90ZStwYV9yaXR0ZXJAZ21haWwuY29tIiwiZXhwIjoxNjg0NDEyNzMxfQ.vmp7nTf3xq5XQoAd-8-rxvVr4hm_Wk7emeLEQEcSCds'
note=apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=2705)
content=note['content']
print('note_title',note['title'])

# Parse: movie titles are lines that do not start with '#' and not starting with '-' and not empty.
# Director lines like ' - director: Peter Jackson'
lines=[ln.rstrip() for ln in content.splitlines()]
movies=[]
current_title=None
dir_val=None

for ln in lines:
    s=ln.strip()
    if not s:
        continue
    if s.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if s.startswith('-'):
        # property line
        if s.lower().startswith('- director:'):
            dir_val=s.split(':',1)[1].strip()
        continue
    # title line
    # when we encounter a new title, save prior if it had director
    if current_title is not None and dir_val is not None:
        movies.append((current_title,dir_val))
        dir_val=None
    current_title=s

# save last
if current_title is not None and dir_val is not None:
    movies.append((current_title,dir_val))

# Filter by director
filtered=[title for title,dirv in movies if dirv=='Peter Jackson']
print('total_parsed',len(movies))
print('filtered_count',len(filtered))
print('filtered_titles',filtered)

# Also show unique-preserving order
seen=set(); uniq=[]
for t in filtered:
    if t not in seen:
        uniq.append(t); seen.add(t)
print('filtered_unique_count',len(uniq))
print('filtered_unique_titles',uniq)
